subject: Conversion of classes "difftime", "Date" and "POSIXct" in factor by unmarkedFrameOccu()

messages.author: 1bbd1bb312ff7417
messages.subject: Conversion of classes "difftime", "Date" and "POSIXct" in factor by unmarkedFrameOccu()
parts:
Hello everybody,

I was formatting data for an occupancy model and stumbled upon something that could potentially cause issues for some analyses.

Some of the covariates I'm using for the observation process include objects of class "difftime", "POSIXct" and "Date" (for sampling duration, start and end times, and days, respectively). When using "unmarkedFrameOccu()" to format the data for "occu()", it automatically converts those classes as factors (without any warning). This should be ok for an analysis where the date is considered as a factor, but could cause problems in other situations, such as the case where survey durations are converted to factors.

As a temporary fix, you can manually convert those parameters as numerics prior inputting them in "unmarkedFrameOccu()". From what I gathered, Richard is already working on a fix for this problem. In the mean time, it can be useful to check that the classes of your covariates correspond to what you wish. A simple analysis of the structure of your unmarkedFrameOccu object (with "str()") should do the trick.

Regards,

Florent
